symbols.name: position set
symbols.meaning: The finite set of positions on which a permutation acts.
symbols.quote: Here $\mathcal P$ is the finite set of positions, and $\upsilon$ is a permutation of it, the map that sends each position to its new position.

symbols.name: permutation
symbols.meaning: A bijection of the position set onto itself, which sends each position to its new position.
symbols.quote: Here $\mathcal P$ is the finite set of positions, and $\upsilon$ is a permutation of it, the map that sends each position to its new position.

relations.quote: A permutation of $\mathcal P$ is defined as a [bijection](bijection.md) of $\mathcal P$ onto itself, that is, a map $\upsilon$ from $\mathcal P$ to $\mathcal P$ that is one-to-one (no two positions have the same image) and onto (every position is an image).
